request.deadline: 12 months after the existing contract closes
deliverables: Maintenance of the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation
Maintenance of official SDKs, including dependency updates, performance improvements, and bug fixing
Community support, including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public communication
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for a TxPipe vendor project
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for maintenance and enhancement over 12 months, including a part-time maintainer and related administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
The motivation text says the underlying maintainer request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification that standardizes interactions with UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposal states that UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and to be open-source under Apache 2.0.
The proposal states that work will cover protobuf specification maintenance, official SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting documentation, audited results, and an audit report.

The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not, alone or in aggregate at submission time, breach the 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.

The proposal states that Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-like role thresholds, an external Oversight Committee, and dashboard/on-chain auditability.

The proposal states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance project by TxPipe administered through Intersect, with technical scope, budget line items, governance-process references, smart-contract administration details, and prior-funding assertions, but it does not provide a complete standalone feasibility, risk, alternatives, failure-mode, or detailed budget analysis.
